instruction: 수집을 먼저 수행하고 남은 공백은 수집한 내용을 바탕으로 작성한다. 의미상 중복은 추가하지 않는다.
scope: DB entries and descriptions only, explicitly confirmed by the user on 2026-10-30. No reference-image production, paid generation, media acquisition or remote deployment.
completion_rules: Compare the full current category, accepted concepts and aliases before collecting or authoring.
Enrich the same existing ID when the underlying concept already exists; a translated name, gender label, color change or wording change is not a new concept.
Collect readable primary evidence for missing factual dimensions before authoring creative directions.
Use collected facts as explicit inputs to separately labeled creative proposals; never attribute an invented combination or observed result to a source.
Rejected facts stay rejected unless replacement evidence is independently reviewed against a new input SHA; a proposal cannot launder rejected facts into verified status.
Keep web-approved, creative-authored, applied and remaining-shortfall counts separate.
Do not count creative proposals as new verified web concepts or as acquired or reviewed media.
Review semantic uniqueness and factual-versus-creative labeling before local DB application.

description_gap_audit.method: Read every current hair/makeup title, description and detail keys; compare exact approved concept targets. Absence of web review is not absence of a description.
description_gap_audit.decision: Enrich these existing IDs rather than create renamed copies. The other 35 already contain design directions, preservation rules and QA criteria; do not manufacture new entries merely because they lack web review.
description_gap_audit.not_yet_done: None: 16 existing-ID directions independently reviewed, applied, API-checked and representative desktop/mobile rendered.

completed_work: Audit missing dimensions within the existing 29 hair and 22 makeup entries without web review.
Collect missing evidence, then author nonduplicative creative directions for genuine remaining gaps.
Independently review the supplement and integrate through a deterministic, duplicate-safe local path.
Verify factual and creative labeling on actual API and rendered detail pages.

result.input_snapshot_note: creative-supplement.json remains byte-immutable with its original draft label; effective acceptance is the matching independent review and creative-revision.json, not that historical label.
